Massachusetts MATHCOUNTS[edit]

The Massachusetts MATHCOUNTS team is one of the top-performing programs in the country, having earned five national team championships: 2012, 2013, 2019, 2025, and 2026. Sponsored by the Massachusetts Society of Professional Engineers (MSPE) since 1983, the program most recently captured back-to-back national titles in 2025 and 2026. Massachusetts has also posted a long run of strong national finishes, including second place in 2024 and third place in both 2015 and 2023.

National Countdown Competition Champions[edit]

  • 2013: Alec Sun
  • 2019: Daniel Mai

National Written Competition Champions[edit]

  • 2013: Alec Sun
  • 2019: Jeff Lin

2026 National MATHCOUNTS Competition[edit]

Team Massachusetts claimed its second consecutive national championship at the 2026 National MATHCOUNTS Competition in Orlando, Florida, finishing first out of 56 state teams. The 2026 team:

  • Shlok Mukund
  • Yonis Gulleth
  • Max Wang
  • Brandon Ni

Individual Achievements[edit]

Massachusetts has produced several of the nation's top individual mathletes:

  • 2013: Alec Sun — National Countdown and Written Champion
  • 2019: Jeff Lin — National Written Champion
  • 2019: Daniel Mai — National Countdown Champion
  • 2024: Selena Ge — Second Place Individual (Countdown Round)

National Championship Teams[edit]

  • 2012 — National Champions
  • 2013 — National Champions (team included National Countdown and Written Champion Alec Sun)
  • 2019 — National Champions: Max Xu, Daniel Mai, Jeff Lin, Kaylee Ji
  • 2025 — National Champions: Brandon Ni, Shlok Mukund, Eric Huang, Soham Samanta
  • 2026 — National Champions: Shlok Mukund, Yonis Gulleth, Max Wang, Brandon Ni
